name: Pro Toss Right
purpose: Get the ball outside fast with the tight end and flanker already out there to block. Against a defense that has widened to cover our receivers this is a foot race we can win.

X.rule: Run off the defender covering you and take him out of the play.

LT.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

LG.rule: Block back. Take the first defender on or inside you. Nobody crosses your face.

C.rule: Reach the man over you. If nobody is over you, cut off the backside.

RG.rule: Reach the first defender to the playside. Head across his outside shoulder.

RT.rule: Reach the man on or outside you. If you cannot reach him, run him past the play.

TE.rule: Reach the man over you and turn him in. Let the ball go around you.

Z.rule: Block the deepest defender on your side. Run at his outside number.

QB.rule: Reverse pivot and toss the ball out in front of the halfback so he catches it running. Then get out of the way.

FB.rule: Beat the halfback to the corner and kick out the first defender who shows.

HB.rule: Catch the toss on the run and get to the corner. Turn up off the fullback's block, not before.

coaching_points: The toss goes out in front. If the halfback has to stop for it the play is dead.
Best call when they have walked a defender out to cover our flanker — that is one fewer man in the box.
